(ἀ- neg., ῥώννυμι), [in LXX: 3Ki.14:5Α, Mal.1:8 (חָלָה), Sir.7:35 * ;]
feeble, sickly: Mat.14:14, Mrk.6:5, 13 16:18, 1Co.11:30.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Jesus went out, and he saw a great multitude. He had compassion on them, and healed their sick.
He could do no mighty work there, except that he laid his hands on a few sick people, and healed them.
For this cause many among you are weak and sickly, and not a few sleep.
